method: Exact right-continuous empirical CDF per mouse/day; subtract D0 from D14 within each mouse, then equal mouse group mean and SEM. SEM is descriptive, not cage-adjusted or simultaneous confidence. No hypothesis tests.
selection: Same 42 mice and all retained slips as D0/D14 CDFs; including during stops and outside tape, no clipping or smoothing.
validation: Paired-mean changes equal D14 minus D0 earlier group ECDFs to atol1e-14; terminal values zero.
interpretation: Positive indicates increased fraction of events <= that score, not fewer events per crossing.
